findings.message: Stale doc statement in section 6.7: "Premise park: after `premise_failed`, the stem waits until its committed `ticket.md` changes. The re-offer draws no retry." With the new default `premise_bounce: 1`, the first `premise_failed` spends the cap. `runner.drive` then routes the stem to the Reject queue through the mechanical `premise_bounce cap spent` verdict (the diff's own change to tests/test_terminal.py pins `dispatch: reject_queue, routed: reject_queue`). `drain._select` skips a queued stem with no budget, so a `ticket.md` edit alone never releases it, and the ticket itself notes that an edit release now needs a second premise bounce.
findings.paved_road: Update the section 6.7 premise-park bullet to match: under the default `premise_bounce: 1`, the first `premise_failed` routes to the Reject queue and only an operator `confirm` releases it. The park-until-`ticket.md`-changes release, with its no-retry re-offer, applies only when a host sets `premise_bounce` above 1.
